g.text: Create a generic 2D placeholder character sprite sheet for a Unity
game, art direction intentionally undefined. One player and one
enemy, each with idle, 4-frame walk and 2-frame jump. 64x64 frames
on a transparent PNG sheet, flat four-colour palette (dark outline,
mid fill, light highlight, accent), simple readable silhouettes, no
text, no logos, no copyrighted characters.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
